title: Buyer’s Resources
text: BUYER’S RESOURCES The following big-league tea companies sell quality leaf and ship their products nationwide. But don’t overlook local tea vendors. Search for one who stocks an excellent selection of carefully chosen tea and from whom you can learn about the subtleties of tea. Visit often and purchase a small quantity of every tea they sell. A good relationship with a local tea merchant is a valuable opportunity to taste a wide variety of tea and build tea knowledge, putting you on the fast track to experiencing their best teas as well as seasonal or rare teas when they arrive. For more on purchasing tea, see chapter 6 .
